title.zh: Dmanisi A层：石器留下早期行踪
title.en: Dmanisi Stratum A: tools mark an early presence

answer.zh: Dmanisi较早地层中的石器，说明约185万至178万年前已有早期人族在这里反复活动。
answer.en: Stone tools in Dmanisi's earlier deposits show repeated hominin activity here about 1.85-1.78 million years ago.

explanation.zh: 石器不必与头骨一起出现，仍能成为活动的证据。研究者把A层石器所在的沉积顺序，与火山岩年代和古地磁记录结合，约束早期到达欧亚的人族活动时间。多层记录更像几次留下的足迹，而不是一座连续住满数万年的聚落；仅凭石器也不能确定造作者属于哪一种早期人族。
explanation.en: Tools can document activity even without an accompanying skull. Researchers combined the order of the tool-bearing sediments with volcanic-rock dates and magnetic records to constrain early hominin occupation in Eurasia. Repeated evidence in successive deposits is not the same as a settlement occupied continuously for tens of thousands of years. Tools alone also do not identify their makers to a particular species.

text.zh: Ferring等人的研究把A层中的石器与1.85至1.78 Ma之间的重复占据联系起来。
text.en: Ferring and colleagues link tools in Stratum A to repeated occupations between 1.85 and 1.78 Ma.

text.zh: 火山地层、氩同位素测年和古地磁提供时间约束；著名人类化石主要来自另一个较年轻层位。
text.en: Volcanic stratigraphy, argon dating and palaeomagnetism constrain the chronology. The well-known hominin fossils mainly come from a different, younger horizon.

caveats.zh: A层石器的较早年龄不能直接贴到B层头骨上。
caveats.en: The earlier age of the Stratum A tools cannot simply be assigned to Stratum B skulls.

caveats.zh: 这不是现代智人已在当时到达这里的证据，也不证明整个时间范围都有人居住。
caveats.en: This is not evidence that modern humans were already here, or that occupation continued throughout the full interval.

timeNote.zh: 记录范围约185万至178万年前；约180万年前是这段范围内的浏览年代，不是单件石器的精确年龄。
timeNote.en: The record spans about 1.85-1.78 million years ago. The browsing age of about 1.8 million years lies within it and is not an exact date for an individual tool.

precision.zh: 论文公开的遗址位置，原坐标写至角秒；不代表每件石器的探方位置或已知的米级准确性。
precision.en: The published site position, expressed to an arcsecond; not an excavation-square coordinate for each tool or a known metre-level accuracy.

title.zh: Dmanisi B层：头骨记录早期人属
title.en: Dmanisi Stratum B: fossils of early Homo

answer.zh: 约177万年前的Dmanisi化石，让我们直接看到早期人属在非洲以外生活的身体证据。
answer.en: Dmanisi's approximately 1.77-million-year-old fossils provide bodily evidence of early Homo living outside Africa.

explanation.zh: 与更早A层中的石器不同，B层主要的人类化石保存了可比较的身体特征。这些遗骸帮助研究者讨论早期人属的差异、迁移与演化。研究者对具体种级分类仍有不同解释，但化石为早期人属已经生活在非洲以外提供了直接的身体证据。
explanation.en: Unlike the earlier tools in Stratum A, the main hominin fossils in Stratum B preserve anatomical features that can be compared. They inform debates about variation, dispersal and evolution in early Homo. Researchers differ on species-level classification, but the remains provide direct anatomical evidence of early Homo living outside Africa.

text.zh: 2011年研究区分了较早的A层活动和约1.77 Ma的B层主要人类化石。
text.en: The 2011 study distinguishes earlier Stratum A occupations from the principal Stratum B hominin fossils at about 1.77 Ma.

text.zh: 化石所在的地层背景让身体遗骸能够与时间联系起来，而不是只凭头骨外形猜测年代。
text.en: The fossils' geological context links the remains to a chronology rather than dating them from skull shape alone.

caveats.zh: 具体种级分类存在讨论，不能把某个名称当作唯一无争议答案。
caveats.en: Species-level classification is debated; no single name should be presented as the only uncontested answer.

caveats.zh: 这组化石不与较早A层石器共用185万年前的年龄。
caveats.en: These fossils do not inherit the 1.85-million-year age of the earlier Stratum A tools.

timeNote.zh: 约177万年前是主要化石层的概括年龄，不是精确到某年的出生或死亡日期。
timeNote.en: About 1.77 million years is an approximate age for the main fossil horizon, not a precise year of birth or death.

precision.zh: 论文给出的遗址位置，不是每件头骨的出土坐标；实测位置误差未知。
precision.en: The site position published in the paper, not the findspot of every skull; measured positional uncertainty is unknown.

title.zh: Jebel Irhoud：早期智人的时间线
title.en: Jebel Irhoud: dating early Homo sapiens

answer.zh: 与Jebel Irhoud人类遗骸相关的受热燧石，把这组早期智人证据放在约31.5万年前。
answer.en: Heated flints associated with the Jebel Irhoud human remains place this evidence of early Homo sapiens at about 315,000 years ago.

explanation.zh: 火的作用让燧石能够接受热释光测年，帮助研究者为相关遗骸建立年代。研究报告的加权年龄为315±34千年，提醒我们测年结果带有不确定性。遗骸被研究者归入早期智人，但这不意味着一处遗址就找到了全人类唯一的出生地点，也不意味着演化在那一刻突然完成。
explanation.en: Heating made the flints suitable for thermoluminescence dating, helping researchers establish a chronology for the associated remains. The reported weighted age is 315,000 years with an uncertainty of 34,000 years. Researchers assign the remains to early Homo sapiens, but a single site is not humanity's sole birthplace, nor does it mean evolution was completed at one moment.

text.zh: Richter等人对与新发现遗骸直接相关的受热燧石进行测年，报告315±34 ka的加权年龄。
text.en: Richter and colleagues dated heated flints directly associated with the newly found remains, reporting a weighted age of 315 +/- 34 ka.

text.zh: MPI的研究发布将新遗骸与早期智人的演化联系起来，并介绍了配套的形态与年代研究。
text.en: The MPI research announcement connects the new remains with early Homo sapiens and introduces the companion anatomical and dating studies.

caveats.zh: 主要年龄来自相关受热燧石，不是每一块人骨都直接测得相同年龄。
caveats.en: The principal age comes from associated heated flints; it is not an identical direct date for every human bone.

caveats.zh: 不能把测年误差变成确定的连续居住期，或把不同测年方法的结果拼成一个生存范围。
caveats.en: Dating uncertainty is not a proven interval of continuous residence, and results from different methods should not be joined into a lifespan.

timeNote.zh: 约31.5万年前；论文报告315±34 ka。测年不确定性不等于已知的连续居住期，也不是确定的起止年份。
timeNote.en: About 315,000 years ago; the paper reports 315 +/- 34 ka. Dating uncertainty does not establish a continuous occupation period or definite start and end years.

precision.zh: 遗址地区索引，不是单件化石或炉火的实测位置；测量误差未知。
precision.en: A site-area index, not a surveyed position for an individual fossil or fire; measurement uncertainty is unknown.

title.zh: Chauvet：画作与炭迹记录两段故事
title.en: Chauvet: art and charcoal reveal two chapters

answer.zh: 画作、炭迹和测年结果表明，人类在Chauvet洞穴的活动有两段主要阶段，并非一段连续不变的历史。
answer.en: Art, charcoal traces and dating results identify two main phases of human activity in Chauvet Cave, rather than one continuous, unchanging occupation.

explanation.zh: 研究者不仅看图画风格，还测量炭样，并结合画面叠压、洞穴环境与不同材料的测年。2016年的综合研究把主要活动概括为两个校准年代范围。洞中的动物画面体现了人的观察与表达，但画了一种动物，并不等于已经在同一位置发现了那种动物的骨骼。
explanation.en: Researchers did more than compare artistic styles. They dated charcoal and combined the results with overlapping marks, cave history and dates from different materials. The 2016 synthesis summarizes two principal calibrated activity ranges. Animal images reveal human observation and expression, but painting an animal is not the same as finding its bones at that location.

text.zh: Quiles等人的研究综合多种测年与考古信息，区分约37,000至33,500和31,000至28,000校准年前的活动阶段。
text.en: Quiles and colleagues combine dating and archaeological evidence to distinguish activity at approximately 37,000-33,500 and 31,000-28,000 calibrated years before present.

text.zh: 法国文化部的介绍说明这里保存着早期洞穴艺术，并区分不开放的原洞穴与面向公众的复制洞。
text.en: The French Ministry of Culture describes the early cave art and distinguishes the original cave, closed to public visits, from the public replica.

caveats.zh: 两段范围之间的间隔不能补写为有人持续活动；也不是每幅画都得到了同样精度的日期。
caveats.en: The interval between the phases is not evidence of continuous activity, and individual paintings are not all dated with equal precision.

caveats.zh: 校准年代不能与未经校准的碳十四年龄直接混用；动物画面也不能代替动物化石证据。
caveats.en: Calibrated ages cannot be mixed directly with uncalibrated radiocarbon ages; animal depictions cannot replace fossil evidence.

timeNote.zh: 两段年代以1950年为距今基准，是活动阶段的约数。地点使用现今参考基图，不表示当时的海岸线或边界。
timeNote.en: The two ranges are approximate activity phases in calibrated years before 1950. The location uses a present-day reference basemap, not the coastlines or boundaries of that time.

precision.zh: 原洞穴的地点索引，不是作品、入口或复制洞的精确定位；位置误差未知。
precision.en: A place index for the original cave, not a precise position for an artwork, entrance or replica; positional uncertainty is unknown.

title.zh: Chauvet洞熊：骨骼是另一条证据
title.en: Chauvet's cave bears: a separate trail of evidence

answer.zh: Chauvet洞内测年的洞熊骨骼，直接说明动物也曾利用这里，不必借壁画来推测它们的存在。
answer.en: Dated cave-bear bones inside Chauvet directly show that animals used the cave, independently of what the paintings depict.

explanation.zh: 骨骼与炭画回答的是不同问题：前者记录动物遗骸，后者记录人类表达。研究者对洞熊骨骼进行放射性碳测年，并用模型估计活动阶段的起止。这个范围包含边界的不确定性，不是每只熊的寿命，更不是证明在这段时间里每天都有熊住在洞中。
explanation.en: Bones and charcoal drawings answer different questions: one records animal remains, the other human expression. Researchers radiocarbon-dated cave-bear bones and modelled the boundaries of an occupation phase. The range includes uncertainty in those boundaries. It is neither the lifespan of each bear nor proof that bears occupied the cave every day throughout the interval.

text.zh: 2016年研究对鉴定为洞熊Ursus spelaeus的骨骼进行测年，这与人类艺术活动的证据分别分析。
text.en: The 2016 study dates bones identified as the cave bear Ursus spelaeus, analysing them separately from evidence of human artistic activity.

text.zh: 论文Table 1的洞熊模型给出带不确定性的起止边界；这里采用48,300至32,700校准年前的外包络。
text.en: The cave-bear model in Table 1 gives uncertain start and end boundaries. The outer envelope used here is 48,300-32,700 calibrated years before present.

caveats.zh: 范围外包络不是单根骨头的精确年龄，也不是整个洞熊类群的生存期。
caveats.en: The outer envelope is not an exact date for an individual bone or the full temporal range of cave bears.

caveats.zh: 熊与人的年代范围重叠，不能单独证明它们曾在洞中面对面相遇。
caveats.en: Overlapping age ranges do not by themselves demonstrate that bears and people met inside the cave.

timeNote.zh: 这是以1950年为基准的校准年代，采用模型边界的不确定性外包络。现今参考基图只帮助找到洞穴，不还原当时海岸线。
timeNote.en: These are calibrated years before 1950, using the outer envelope of uncertain model boundaries. The present-day reference basemap locates the cave; it does not reconstruct contemporary coastlines.

precision.zh: 洞穴级索引，不是取样骨骼的洞内坐标；测量误差未知。
precision.en: A cave-level index, not an internal coordinate for a sampled bone; measurement uncertainty is unknown.
